name: Spaceship a13d3fbf on 3.3.3.4.4
description: A period-8 spaceship on the elongated triangular tiling 3.3.3.4.4 (touching neighbours), 13 to 17 cells, moving two lattice steps every 8 generations (c/4). It runs the same way in the 1,024 rules from B46/S3458 to B4,6,9,10,11,12/S0,1,3,4,5,8,9,10,11,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. The same object runs unchanged on k3-051 and k3-052. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 2 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
